# You want to contribute?

Thanks for taking the time to help make **easypygamewidgets** better! We appreciate all contributions whether it's reporting bugs, improving the documentation or submitting code fixes and new ideas.

---

Here are a few easy guidelines to help you:

## How Can I Contribute?

### 1. Reporting Bugs
Found a glitch?
- **Check existing issues:** Make sure the bug hasn't already been reported [here](https://github.com/PizzaPost/easypygamewidgets/issues).
- **Open a new issue:** Use a clear title, a minimal reproducible example, your Python/pygame-ce version and the behaviour you expected vs. what actually happens.
- **Wait:** Wait until we fix your bug :)

### 2. Suggesting Features & Improvements
Have an idea for a new widget or a better way to do something?
- **Check existing issues:** Make sure the idea hasn't already been reported [here](https://github.com/PizzaPost/easypygamewidgets/issues).
- **Open a new issue:** Open an issue describing your idea.
- **(Optional) Example:** Give an example code if you want so that we can see better how you image the feature to be implemented.
